cases.question: Across the Balkans & Eastern Mediterranean group, which cities explicitly quantify public EV charging rollout in the corpus, and what is the combined scale? Start with a table listing only the cities that give an explicit public charging figure, the number, and what the number refers to. When a city gives a split charging scheme across categories, sum those category counts into one city total and note the category split. When a city gives both historic and planned public charging figures, use the future planned rollout figure. If a city states station counts rather than point counts, use the station count as written rather than converting it. Then end with a section titled Numeric summary using these exact metric labels on separate lines: coverage_count, combined_public_charging_total, largest_public_charging_value.

cases.question: Across the frozen 102-city corpus, which city files explicitly state a future city-level electric or zero-emission bus count in narrative or action-plan text? Start with a table listing only those cities, the count, and what the count refers to. Count only future procurement, rollout, or target figures; exclude current in-service fleet counts. Prefer the broadest explicit city-level future electric or zero-emission bus programme figure rather than interim deliveries or special sub-fleet counts. When a city states one future electric-bus programme as split tranches in the same action-plan text, sum those tranches into one city total and note the split. Exclude percentages, ranges, indicator-table-only values, and clearly regional figures outside the city scope. Then end with a section titled Numeric summary using these exact metric labels on separate lines: coverage_count, combined_zero_emission_bus_total, largest_zero_emission_bus_value.
